loiGiai: \begin{center} \end{center} Gọi $M$ là trung điểm $AC$ khi đó $\begin{cases} (SAC) \perp (ABC) \\ SM \perp AC \end{cases} \Rightarrow SM \perp (ABC)$.\\ Ta có $\begin{cases} AC \perp SM \\ AC \perp BM \end{cases} \Rightarrow AC \perp (SBM) \Rightarrow AC \perp SB$.\\ Trong $(SAB)$ dựng $AH \perp SB$ khi đó $SB \perp (AHC)$ vậy $[A,SB,C] = \widehat{AHC}$.\\ Trong tam giác $ABC$ có $AC = 2AM = 2AB \cos \widehat{BAM} = 2a \cos 30^\circ = a\sqrt{3}$.\\ $BM = AB \sin \widehat{BAC} = a \sin 30^\circ = \displaystyle\frac{1}{2}a$.\\ Do tam giác $SAC$ đều nên $SM = AC \displaystyle\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = a\sqrt{3} \cdot \displaystyle\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \displaystyle\frac{3}{2}a$.\\ Trong tam giác $SMB$ có $MH = \displaystyle\frac{SM \cdot BM}{\sqrt{SM^2 + BM^2}} = \displaystyle\frac{\displaystyle\frac{3}{2}a \cdot \displaystyle\frac{1}{2}a}{\sqrt{\displaystyle\frac{9}{4}a^2 + \displaystyle\frac{1}{4}a^2}} = \displaystyle\frac{3a}{2\sqrt{10}}$.\\ Trong tam giác vuông $AMH$ có $\tan \widehat{AHM} = \displaystyle\frac{AM}{HM} = \displaystyle\frac{\displaystyle\frac{a\sqrt{3}}{2}}{\displaystyle\frac{3a}{2\sqrt{10}}} = \sqrt{\displaystyle\frac{10}{3}}$.\\ $\widehat{AHM} \approx 61{,}3^\circ \Rightarrow \widehat{AHC} = 2 \cdot \widehat{AHM} \approx 123^\circ$.
